message: スウィーツ革命

name: Shina-oba
message: 「So I just need to put up this poster?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thank you, Auntie!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「If you want, I can talk to the shops around here and have them put some up too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We appreciate it, but it's the thought that counts」

name: Synn
message: 「Since we're the ones asking them to put them up, we need to properly greet each place one by one」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「True enough. Being Student Council President is really starting to suit you, Synn-chan」

name: Synn
message: 「Not at all... I still have a long way to go」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's right. He's still so unreliable」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「You two sound just like a young wife propping up her hopeless husband」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What are you saying! Honestly」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you hitting my back!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「She's just hiding her embarrassment. You still don't understand a woman's heart at all, Synn-chan. Maybe I should give you a little lecture\s05」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-We're fine. We'll pass! L-Let's go, Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「Stop pulling me--thank you very much」

name: Nanaka
message: 「With this, almost all the participating shops have put up our posters, right」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see... I'll check right now... check this one, and this one, and this one... yeah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then that wraps up today's Student Council activities」

name: Synn
message: 「We finished way earlier than I thought we would. That's all thanks to Nanaka's--」
hard work, I was about to say, when she cut in.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, shall we meet up with the detached team?」

name: Synn
message: 「Detached team?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin. Oh, it's me. How are things on your end?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Going smoothly! Okay. Just one final push to get new members--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? What? Anyway, we're meeting up. I'll fill you in on the details then. Right now I'm at the crossroads near Shinagawa Greengrocer」

name: Synn
message: 「Did something happen to Sacchin?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't really get it myself, but hey, we'll find out once we meet up」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hey there, you two--」

name: Sally
message: 「Sweets are the best!」

name: Synn
message: 「Out of nowhere!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, sweets are the best!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So yeah, that's how it is--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I have no idea what 'So yeah, that's how it is--' is supposed to mean」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Blah blah, yadda yadda--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh. I see」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, sorry. I don't get it at all」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, you're a big shot, right」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well... I wonder about that?」

name: Sally
message: 「If you're a big shot, you should pass a law saying nobody in the world is allowed to eat anything except sweets」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You see, for 'Operation Brainwash Sally,' I fed her a whole bunch of sweets to hammer home just how delicious they are--」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka... no matter how badly you want to expand the club...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wish she'd at least kept the operation name a secret... though it's too late now」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahaha-- It's too late now--」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, Prez. Rewrite the law, gotta buy more sweets」

name: Synn
message: 「Heyy. Sally's broken」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmm. The brainwashing worked a little too well. I miiight have fed her a bit too much. I kept count up to twenty, though--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「J-Just because it was coming out of my wallet, you... I picked the wrong person for the job!」
I felt like the exact same thing happened with Nanaka's underclassman Okamoto-san, too, but out of a warrior's mercy, I kept my mouth shut.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Don't worry. I held back and held back, and only ate three for myself~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...You bought your own share yourself, right?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No way, I believe in Nana-chan being super generous~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't believe in me! Give my wallet back right now. And return your share while you're at it」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Stingy~. Here」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uuugh... Drastically reduced...」

name: Sally
message: 「Boss Nanaka. The Prez won't make the law for us. Should I have the Delicious Food Squad--newly renamed the Sweets Squad--rough 'em up?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, violence is out of the question for a Sweets Club poised to take flight across the world」

name: Synn
message: 「To me, it only looks like it's on the verge of sinking right here in Ryuusei Town, though」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun, that's a sharp comeback~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh. You don't get it. None of you get it!」

name: Sally
message: 「Sweets are the best!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Fufufu. Brainwashing--ahem, educating Sally-chan is the first step toward a grand ambition!」

name: Synn
message: 「I doubt there's even going to be a second step, though」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If I keep brainwashing demons one after another and dyeing them in sweets ideology like this, the Sweets Club will spread its wings beyond the narrow world of Ryuusei Academy--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And make a name for itself as a global club that even has demons as members!」
Better not say a word.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then membership will skyrocket. As an ultra-famous club, branches will be established one after another off-campus, and eventually overseas and even in the Demon World! Plus, the formation of the Japan Sweets Party!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Seizing power! Ruling Japan! A sweets revolution sweeping the globe! The world is one family, and all of humanity eats nothing but sweets!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uwahahahahahaha」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka... Your direction has completely changed」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So even when it's global, it's still just a hobby club~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urgh」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, what's a soba shop supposed to do if the whole world only eats sweets, huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urgh」

name: Sally
message: 「Sweets! Long live sweets! Anything that isn't sweets is pig slop!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah, that's right. Long live sweets!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-Anyway, the die is cast and I've crossed the Rubicon, so there's no turning back now until the World Sweets Revolution is complete!」

name: Synn
message: 「As your childhood friend, this is my final warning. Turn back.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It'll be fiiine. There's no way a plan this detached from reality is gonna work out anyway~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, I don't wanna hear that from you, Sacchin」

name: Sally
message: 「Long live the Sweets Revolution! Until the world burns to ashes in sweets!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「See, even the brainwashing went this well. It's totally grounded in reality.」

name: Synn
message: 「Undo it for her.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know, I don't think humans should ever look back.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun, it's fiiine. She's definitely gonna fail. If stuff like this actually worked, we wouldn't still only have three club members~」

name: Synn
message: 「Good point. Wait, Sacchin, you sound surprisingly sharp today.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe. Praise me, praise me~」

name: Girl
message: 「Nanaka-han sure is lively as ever, isn't she~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mgh! That voice!?」

name: Girl
message: 「Good afternoon, President-han.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, hello. Huh, Ria-senpai?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Good afternoon, President-han.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh. Hello, Misasagi-senpai. Huh, Ria-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Um, well. I finished up today's work and thought I'd buy some tea sweets for the first time in a while, and then I ran into Ayanishiki-chan」

name: Synn
message: 「Ayanishiki-chan... meaning」

name: Ria
message: 「My friend. She's the president of the Wagashi Club♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahhh, so you're the Misasagi-senpai Nanaka talks about all the time.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bu-bu-zu-ke!!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「My, what a terrible thing to call someone」

name: Synn
message: 「How lovely it is to get along」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hello there~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ria-senpai. I really think you ought to be more selective with your friends」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I couldn't agree more. Though in the Student Council, where members are chosen from whoever runs, that's simply out of our hands」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...And what's that supposed to mean?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Please don't drag me into this」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn. You don't need to bother greeting someone like her」

name: Synn
message: 「A cheerful greeting is important, you know~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Plus, I don't wanna make unnecessary waves~」

name: Ria
message: 「U-um, well. I don't think it's good to pick a fight right off the bat」

name: Sally
message: 「Boss Nanaka. Who's this person?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Madam President. Who might this little one be? I don't believe I've seen her face before」

name: Synn
message: 「This girl is, well, how do I put it...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ah, could she be the Sally-chan you've spoken of?」

name: Sally
message: 「Am I famous or something!?」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm the one who told her about you」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, that explains it」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Sally-chan, Sally-chan, Sally-chan... What a lovely name」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa! She just complimented me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't fall for it, Sally-chan! She might look like that, but she's the enemy! Keep your guard up!」

name: Sally
message: 「Got it! So you're the bubuzuke standing in the way of our sweets revolution!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Found out so quickly, was I? How careless of me.」

name: Sally
message: 「So you're the president of the evil organization 'Wagashi Club'!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I am Ayae Misasagi, representative of the secret evil society, Wagashi Club.」

name: Ria
message: 「Eeeh?! Since when did that happen?」

name: Synn
message: 「Please don't provoke Sally-chan.」

name: Sally
message: 「Now that we've met, your luck's run out! Sally-chan, representative of the Delicious Food Squad--now renamed the Sweets Squad--is gonna bring divine punishment down on the evil boss!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「My, what an energetic child. Though before we get into all that complicated business, there's something we must do first.」

name: Sally
message: 「Something we must do?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Something you love very much.」

name: Sally
message: 「Something I love?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't listen to the devil's words.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「As a token of our acquaintance, it's just a little nothing, but please accept this.」

name: Sally
message: 「W-What is this?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now, now, don't be so frightened. It's food. It's called rakugan.」

name: Sally
message: 「C-Could this be?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's right, Sally-chan. This is the Sweets Revolution's greatest enemy! Wagashi」

name: Sally
message: 「I-I was about to be fed poison! I won't fall for that trick!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Sacchin. What exactly did Nanaka put into Sally-chan's head?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Pretty much exactly what she's saying right now~ Can't help it~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Don't make such a scary face. Besides, if you say you're going to fight, I'd think it's impossible to fight an opponent if you can't even eat them.」

name: Sally
message: 「Mgh」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Or are you already cowering in fear before the fight even begins? Well, fighting is scary for anyone, so it can't be helped. Nobody at all would call you a coward.」

name: Sally
message: 「That's not true! I'll gobble something like this down in one bite!」
Sally-chan snatched the rakugan right out of Misasagi-senpai's hand, and.

name: Sally
message: 「See! Something like this isn't scary at all! Or rather...」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa. This is delicious too! What was this food called again?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's rakugan. I am truly delighted that you've taken a liking to it.」

name: Sally
message: 「I love it! Rakugan is delicious! Sweet and delicious!」
And with that, the sweets revolution comes to THE END.

name: Sacchin
message: 「See, told you it'd fail~」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin is really on point today...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Seeing you eat with such joy makes me happy as well. Would you care to have plenty more?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah. I wanna eat more!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ria, do give her the ones we bought earlier. I'll go buy replacements tomorrow or so.」

name: Ria
message: 「Sally-chan. Here. You can have all of these.」
Inside the box Ria-senpai held out, tiny pieces of rakugan were neatly lined up.

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa. Delicious, delicious, delicious, delicious! Sweet and delicious!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Wagashi are quite wonderful too, aren't they?」

name: Sally
message: 「Uh-huh. Sweets are yummy, but wagashi are great too!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Next time, do introduce me to your friends from the Sweets Squad as well.」

name: Sally
message: 「Sweets Squad? Wrong! It's the Delicious Food Squad! Don't get it wrong!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Right, right, of course. How silly of me to make such a mistake. Please forgive me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka. Isn't it a good thing that Sally-chan isn't a picky eater?」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't think it's something worth fighting over either.」

name: Ria
message: 「Wait, Nanaka-chan!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka! Wait, she came charging back at full speed?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sally-chan!」

name: Sally
message: 「What? I'm busy with my rakugan right now~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Take this!」
What Nanaka thrust out toward Sally-chan was a chocolate banana crepe!

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh, it smells sweet and yummy! Is it good?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Crepes are delicious!」

name: Sally
message: 「I'll eat it!」

name: Sally
message: 「Nom munch chomp, it's good! Sweet and yummy!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good, right?! These are sweets too! Way better than wagashi!!」

name: Sally
message: 「So good~\s07」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now, now, Sally-chan. There's a proverb that says a hasty beggar gets little. Wouldn't it be fine not to jump to conclusions so quickly?」
Saying so, what Misasagi-senpai held out was a manju bun.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nngh, so that's how you're gonna play it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Nanaka... she's at it again」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh, it smells sweet and yummy! Is it good?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I wonder. Still, many folks say this manju is quite delicious」

name: Sally
message: 「I'll eat it!」

name: Sally
message: 「Nom munch chomp, it's good! Sweet and yummy!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Rakugan isn't all there is to wagashi, you know」

name: Sally
message: 「Wagashi is so good~\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hooooold it right there! Objection!」
With that shout, what Nanaka held out was soft-serve ice cream.
Wait, feels like the price tier is dropping...

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh, it smells sweet and yummy! Is it good?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Of course soft-serve is delicious! Come on, eat up, eat up!」

name: Sally
message: 「I'll eat it!」

name: Sally
message: 「Lick lick nom, it's good! Sweet and yummy!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good, right?! These are sweets too! Way better than wagashi!!」

name: Sally
message: 「So good~\s07」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now, now, I don't think it'd be too late to make up your mind after having plenty of this」
Saying so, what Misasagi-senpai held out was a monaka wafer.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nngh. So that's your move this time!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Nanaka... she's at it again」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh, it smells sweet and yummy! Is it good?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You never know how food tastes until you try it, so that's for you to decide after eating. Would you like some monaka?」

name: Sally
message: 「I'll eat it!」

name: Sally
message: 「Nom munch chomp, it's good! Sweet and yummy!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「There are all sorts of wagashi, you know」

name: Sally
message: 「Wagashi is so good~\s07」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huh? I thought Nana-chan would come back right about now~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Wawah. Wh-what!? Are you gonna feed me by any chance? Yay~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We ran out of money because you kept stuffing your face!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It wasn't me~, Sally-chan was the one eating~」

name: Ria
message: 「Um, you know. I've been thinking for a while now. Maybe we don't really need to fight」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah~. Fighting only breeds sorrow~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That's right. As expected of the former Student Council President, Lia's words really carry weight」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... That's my Ria-chan for ya」

name: Paqy
message: 「Pomona!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah! Shut up! At this rate, sweets are gonna lose!」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said. Winning or losing is ridiculous in the first place」

name: Synn
message: 「What's with looking at my face and sighing」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you had any money, Synn, I'd borrow it from you, though」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's no use looking at my face either~. I don't wanna cooperate in such a pointless battle~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Pointless!? Aren't you frustrated as a member of the Sweets Club!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I only specialize in eating, after all~」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, you guys. What are you doing?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「Watch your everyday behavior. You're a Student Council officer, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「What about you, Misa, what brings you here」

name: Misa
message: 「Shopping for dinner」

name: Ria
message: 「Um, you see. How should I put it, well...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's so ridiculous it'd make you laugh if I explained it... quite the complicated affair, really. You won't gain a single penny from it, so wouldn't it be best not to ask?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hah... I don't really understand, but is that so?」

name: Sally
message: 「Aaah! What's that you're holding in your hand?」

name: Misa
message: 「This girl really has no self-control when it comes to food. It's a free sample candy they were handing out in front of the station...」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait, she's already eating it!」

name: Sally
message: 「The candy is yummy! Sweet and yummy!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hehehe, I win! Candy is a Western sweet!」

name: Misa
message: 「Well... if I had to say which...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's a Western sweet, right! A Western sweet!」

name: Misa
message: 「Is that really important enough to press me with that much intensity?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not important」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's important to me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heh heh heh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Japanese sweets are defeated!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I hate to throw cold water on you while you're laughing so merrily, but it's still too early to gloat」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I still have an ace up my sleeve, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What?!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I wonder what would happen if I brought out some 'Sumeragisuika' yokan right now?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Guh. P-pulling out an expensive-sounding trump card out of nowhere! No fair!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is fairness really the issue here?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Bring it out if you think you can!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Are you truly sure you don't mind if I do? I certainly don't mind at all」

name: Synn
message: 「Um. Let's just stop already. Somehow, I'm starting to feel sorry for the sweets」

name: Ria
message: 「I think it's fine if both are delicious. Why isn't that okay?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, I'd be fine with that myself, you know, but since this troublesome person here looks like she's about to cry and insists on keeping it going, I think it's a pointless battle, yet there's no helping it. Forgive me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, don't treat me like some pitiful kid!」

name: Ria
message: 「Setting aside contests and all that, I think in an ordinary household, people eat both. My family does, too」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Mine too, dear」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You lack purity! The god of wagashi is weeping!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The god of wagashi is quite forgiving, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sally-chan! Don't go falling for cheap stuff so easily either!」

name: Sally
message: 「But it's yummy」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I chose the wrong person for the job……」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now, now, don't get so down. Living is all about making mistake after mistake, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're right…… Wait, don't you go comforting me!」

name: Misa
message: 「I just realized something. This girl is always saying 'it's sweet and delicious.' In other words, doesn't anything work as long as it's sweet?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah…… come to think of it, that's true」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan. I'll give you this rice cracker」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Where on earth did that come from!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I got it from a nice lady in Shinagawa earlier」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa! It's salty and crunchy and delicious!」

name: Synn
message: 「After something sweet, a rice cracker really hits the spot」

name: Sally
message: 「I see! It's yummy!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「What a truly honest child. Watching her warms the heart. Quite a big difference from a certain someone, wouldn't you say」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are you talking about me!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I couldn't possibly say from my own lips, now could I」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mgh」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now. Since rice crackers aren't sweets or sweet wagashi, wouldn't ending with this make things nice and clean?」

name: Misa
message: 「Clean or not... what are you even doing?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, for Synn's sake, I'll call it a draw for today!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「What a troublesome person you are. I don't mind letting you have the win, you know?」

name: Ria
message: 「Sayanishiki-chan. Don't provoke her like that\s02」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Forgive me. Teasing this one is just so amusing, you see. There I go saying unnecessary things again」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't toy with people!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now, don't get all worked up. Well then, pardon the intrusion」

name: Ria
message: 「Then, see you all tomorrow」

name: Synn
message: 「See you tomorrow」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, bye-bye from me too」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, I'll walk with you part of the way! Everyone! Don't be late!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aah. Even though I was winning」

name: Synn
message: 「Still going on about that?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, well, whatever. Wouldn't want to make Synn lose face, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I'm the treasurer?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Because we're childhood friends」
